title: CORAL: Infrastructure for Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution
summary: CORAL is an open-source framework by Human-Agent-Society designed for building self-evolving multi-agent organizations. It enables autonomous agents to conduct experiments in isolated worktrees while sharing a persistent knowledge hub to drive open-ended scientific discovery and system optimization.
research_notes: Achieved new SOTA results in kernel engineering and mathematical optimization, including a 20% performance gain over human-level baselines in Anthropic's kernel benchmark.

evolution.summary: Originally a 2025 project focused on collaborative reasoning between LLMs, it evolved in early 2026 into an autonomous research platform. It now supports 'spontaneous organization' where agents form alliances and self-refine their collaborative structures to solve complex engineering and mathematical tasks.
